messages:
zoe-docs: quick find while onboarding a new dev: top of quickstart shows `REDWOOD_KEY` but all SDKs use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Causing 401s.

mike-sdk: ah yeah we've renamed that env var in v1.2.0. README must be updated.

tina-devex: also the Node snippet uses bare `fetch` with no note. many users on older Node copy/paste and hit 'fetch is not defined'.

omar-support: saw a ticket where PowerShell swallowed the header because of double quotes in curl. We should add a PS example.

zoe-docs: proposed minimal changes: 1) canonicalize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` across all code blocks; 2) add a PowerShell curl example using `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY`; 3) replace Node snippet with a compatibility-safe commonjs example or a note to use modern `fetch`.

mike-sdk: can you paste the short Node fallback? I'll include in SDK quickstart mapping.

zoe-docs: small snippet: `const fetch = require('node-fetch'); // npm i node-fetch@2
fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` } })`

tina-devex: add one-line: "SDKs include exponential backoff by default; curl does not." reduces confusion.

ci-bot: docs build scheduled (job 9491). ETA ~ 7m.

omar-support: once live, I'll update the onboarding checklist and close related support tickets.

zoe-docs: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/811 and created UI follow-up to add copy buttons. Closing thread after merge."
